    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.matrix_span_eq_top_of_specialization {D : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} {K : Type u_3} {I : Type u_4} {n : Type u_5} [CommRing D] [Field F] [Field K] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (e : D →+* F) (g : D →+* K) (hg : Function.Injective ⇑g) (M : I → Matrix n n D) (h : Submodule.span F (Set.range fun (i : I) => (M i).map ⇑e) = ⊤) :
    Submodule.span K (Set.range fun (i : I) => (M i).map ⇑g) = ⊤

    A family of matrices with full span at one field-valued specialization has full span after an injective change of coefficients to a field.
